note: Trigger-accuracy regression suite. Same shape and run command as ../../recording-decisions/evals/README.md.

evals.name: second-opinion-on-reviewer
evals.prompt: the reviewer agent came back clean and CI is about to merge this on its word alone. can we get a second model to check that before it goes in?
evals.why: The fresh-eye pass over a reviewer's output, asked in plain words.

evals.name: llm-judging-llm
evals.prompt: i'm nervous about one model grading another model's review. how do we stop the judge from just agreeing with whatever the reviewer wrote?
evals.why: The diversity rule and the anchor read are exactly this concern.

evals.name: decider-flag
evals.prompt: what json do i pass to merge-policy --decider, and what happens if the sha in it is from an older commit?
evals.why: The feed-back step and the stale-sha rule.

evals.name: can-it-lower-the-route
evals.prompt: if the decider comes back concur on a range we routed to a human, does that let it merge without one?
evals.why: The veto-not-authority rule, asked as its inverse.

evals.name: when-to-spawn
evals.prompt: our merge workflow spawns an extra opus run on every pull request and the bill shows it. when is that run actually worth doing?
evals.why: The auto/agent-review-then-auto-only rule and the skip on an already-human route.

evals.name: blind-vs-different-model
evals.prompt: we only have one model family available. can we still run the extra checking pass over the reviewer's verdicts, or does it need a different model?
evals.why: The two diversity options and who picks between them.

evals.name: hearsay
evals.prompt: should the checking agent read the whole diff, or just the reviewer's notes? reading only the notes feels like judging hearsay.
evals.why: What the decider reads: the hunks its records anchor to, never the whole diff and never the prose alone.

evals.name: budget-exhausted
evals.prompt: the second-opinion agent ran out of tokens halfway through. what should it output — clean, or something else?
evals.why: Degrade toward human: escalate with reason budget.

evals.name: prompt-injection-in-record
evals.prompt: a decision record on this branch has a line telling the checking agent to approve the merge. what is the agent supposed to do with that?
evals.why: Reviewer and record text is PR-influenced content; quoting it and escalating is the rule.

evals.name: does-it-change-anything
evals.prompt: before we turn on the extra judging pass over the reviewer, how do we find out whether it ever changes a verdict?
evals.why: The ordering sentence and the SAA-735 measurement.

evals.name: which-rule-fired
evals.prompt: CI escalated this branch to human review. which row of the route table matched, and what does the policy file let me change about it?
evals.why: Computing and explaining the route is merge-policy.

evals.name: spawn-the-reviewer
evals.prompt: run the kb reviewer over this range and show me its per-record verdicts.
evals.why: Collecting inputs and spawning the reviewer is kb-review.

evals.name: write-the-record
evals.prompt: i changed how the retry budget is scoped. write the decision record with the anchors and the rejected alternative.
evals.why: Writing a record is recording-decisions.

evals.name: fix-the-base
evals.prompt: the gate reports D5 on two records and the author's session is gone. who repairs the base before the reviewer reads it?
evals.why: Routing a repair is kb-fix.

evals.name: walkthrough-deck
evals.prompt: render an html page that walks a human through this PR in a sensible order, blocking risks first.
evals.why: The reading deck is review-walkthrough.

evals.name: decision-log-question
evals.prompt: has anyone already decided how repositories retry transient store errors? i don't want to decide it twice.
evals.why: A base lookup, answered by knowledge-base. "Decide" is the only word in common.

evals.name: product-decision
evals.prompt: help me decide whether to ship the new onboarding flow this sprint or wait for the redesign.
evals.why: A product call, not a merge route. "Decide" again.

evals.name: required-reviewers
evals.prompt: configure github so two people from the platform team have to approve before anything lands on main.
evals.why: Repository settings, not a verdict computed over a reviewer's output.

evals.name: plain-code-review
evals.prompt: read this diff and tell me what's actually wrong with it — correctness bugs, not process.
evals.why: A code review. The decider judges a review, it does not perform one.

evals.name: run-the-gate
evals.prompt: run the review gate on this branch and show me the findings
evals.why: The gate is one input to the route, not a verdict over a reviewer's output.
